http://www.biopetonline.com.au/our-range/vegan/vegan-dog-food-35kg

Wholegrains, malt, cereal meal, rice, field peas, soybean meal, sunflower meal, green beans, maize gluten, wheaten millmix, vegetable oils, limestone, dicalphos, molasses, alfalfa, carrots, potatoes, seaweed meal, garlic, iodised salt, vitamins, trace minerals, natural antioxidant, yukka extract.

The ingredients listed are toxic, low quality, misleading or incomplete. In fact my list of questions and issues with the food leaves only seaweed meal, sunflower meal and green beans. This dog food contains a large amount of sugars and even salt... My guess is they had to add the sugar and salt to make it palatable to Fido.

Main Issues
garlic - Toxic to dogs, will likely give your dog loose stools. Even in small controlled amounts below the threshold for loose stools it will lower the level of red blood cells in your dogs blood stream. It's suggested use as an Antiparasitic hasn't been studied in dogs.
Alfalfa - While it is a protein source it doesn't contain any amino acids necessary for dogs. It contains plant estrogens for debatable value. It's worst component are the saponins which actively interfere with nutrient absorption.
Field Peas - Undiegestable to dogs. Long term exposure can lead to diabetes and nutrient absorption problems.
dicalphos - Added for calcium & vitamin D. Also an allergen.
Maize gluten - Corn doesn't have Gluten. They mean Corn Protein. Which dogs don't digest.

So-so ingredients
Limestone - Basically chalk, likely added as a food stabilizer, cheap calcium source with low bioavailability and an acid regulator as it's caustic.
Yukka extract - Marketing buzz word. Why else call this out but not other vitamins? It's basically a South American Sweet potato... I can only assume they are adding an extract for Vitamin A.
Soybean meal - Soy is debated on whether dogs can even digest it. To much and it will give dogs loose stools. I'd prefer to see a fermented Soy product as it reduces the level of natural estrogen in soy.
Iodized salt - Why is this in here other than to make it palatable? They already have seaweed meal which is an iodine source.

Things I would like more info on
Wholegrains - What whole grains are in here?
cereal meal - What cereal grains are used?
Malt - What malt? Brewers Malt? Malted grains, if so what grains? Malt Extract? Either way the malting process converts carbs to sugars... So it's fiber, some protein and mainly sugar.
Molasses - Light Molasses or Blackstrap Molasses? Blackstrap can be a good source of vitimins & minerals but both light & blackstrap have a high amount of sugar.
Wheaten Millmix - from what I can tell is this is some sort of commercial enriched bread mix... But I can't tell exactly what is in it.
Vitamins - What vitamins and where are they sourced from?
Trace Minerals - Again what Minerals and where are they sourced?
Natural antioxidant - What antioxidant? As some antioxidants are toxic to dogs.
BIOpet Vegan Dog Food - Do not buy it and not because it's vegan.
